reason: The inspected source is RDKit's rdkit/Chem/Recap.py at upstream commit 237a1d9027c800784afed8788540f38a3aa595f8 (SHA256 d4f9b96945c2c92c095d758a7f460360dc1a73fb75831bfdb8482f8f9aaec3fc). Delivery scripts/recap_terminal.py is a Python 3 CLI wrapper around that upstream API: it imports rdkit.Chem and rdkit.Chem.Recap, parses the required --smiles string with Chem.MolFromSmiles, validates it is a nonempty RDKit molecule, calls Recap.RecapDecompose(mol) using defaults, then calls root.GetLeaves(). The in-process function is terminal_leaves(smiles). The working directory is the skill directory inside the permitted Docker container. Invocation is python scripts/recap_terminal.py --smiles '<SMILES>'. Output is one JSON object on stdout with sorted unique fragment SMILES and rdkit_version; no files are written. Necessary support is a Python 3 environment with RDKit providing rdkit.Chem and rdkit.Chem.rdChemReactions; no external data files are needed.
